note: Both sets contain the same ten claims with identical content, quotes, and conditions, including the same duplicated generator-torque negative-damping claim. Set B's wording is marginally more faithful (it marks ωφn and ζφ as 'recommended' and attributes the design recommendation to Ref. [10]), but this is a trivial difference. Neither set is wrong on any value or binding, and both omit the same important facts (the negative damping must be compensated by the proportional term; ∂P/∂θ is negative in Region 3 and depends on wind speed, rotor speed, and blade-pitch angle).
remarks: Both sets state the generator-torque-controller negative damping claim twice (once with the extra condition about torque dropping with speed error). Both miss the explicit statement that the negative damping must be compensated by the proportional term in the blade-pitch controller, and the fact that ∂P/∂θ is negative in Region 3 and depends on wind speed, rotor speed, and blade-pitch angle. Set B's tiny edge in labeling ωφn/ζφ as recommended (Ref. [10]) is too small to change the verdict.
